status.main_product: Commercial drone manufacturing and drone-as-a-service (DaaS) operations
status.scope_reason: The company qualifies as a core player because it actively operates end-to-end commercial drone services—such as aerial surveying, mapping, and industrial inspections—under its own name for external clients.
status.evidence: According to company registry records from ZaubaCorp, Indrones Solutions Private Limited is currently active, and official media statements confirm MapmyIndia holds a strategic 20% minority stake rather than complete ownership.

claims.claim: The company reports operating a diverse drone portfolio for its services that includes the Sigma 25 (a lightweight survey-grade drone), the Sigma 100 (a DGCA type-certified multi-payload multi-mission drone), the Sigma 75, and the flagship Vector VTOL drone designed for large terrains.
claims.source: Indrones Official Website (indrones.com) and product pages for Sigma 25, Sigma 100, Sigma 75, and Vector VTOL.

claims.claim: The company has demonstrated extensive flight operations using its fleet, reporting more than 9,000 flight hours and over 165 projects delivered across India.
claims.corrected: The company has demonstrated extensive flight operations using its fleet, reporting more than 9,000 flight hours and over 165 projects delivered across India.
claims.source: Indrones Homepage (indrones.com) states "165+ Projects Delivered" and "9,000+ Flight Hours".

claims.claim: The company reports developing its own proprietary commercial drone models, including the multirotor platforms Sigma100, Sigma 25G, and Sigma 25 Pro, alongside its in-house software operating suite EigenOS.
claims.source: Indrones product pages and portfolio detail the proprietary models Sigma100, Sigma25G, and Sigma25 Pro powered by EigenOS.

claims.claim: The company's indigenously developed Sigma100 and Sigma25G platforms have officially secured Director General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) Type Certification in India.
claims.source: Indrones Official Product Pages for Sigma25G and Sigma100 state both have received DGCA Type Certification.

claims.claim: The company reports developing the EigenOS software suite (including Incharge, Inflight.live, and Inspect) to provide fleet management, live streaming, real-time mission intelligence, and 2D/3D geospatial data analytics.
claims.note: The mention of the 'Inspect' component within the EigenOS software suite could not be definitively verified as performing the specific breakdown of tasks described in the claim.
claims.source: Indrones Website product details for EigenOS and Sigma100.

claims.claim: The company reports developing the proprietary Eigenspace Suite, an advanced software platform that automates drone-captured data processing, 3D point cloud generation, photogrammetry, visual data analysis, and dashboard delivery.

In February 2026, Indrones Solutions Pvt. Ltd. announced that its proprietary Eigenspace Suite has been officially validated and integrated into Bentley Systems' global Ecosystem Catalog to ingest aerial datasets into digital twins.

Indrones Solutions Pvt. Ltd. received its first official DGCA Type Certification for its survey-grade drone platform, the Sigma 25G, which is certified by the Directorate General of Civil Aviation for mapping and multi-payload support.

The company expanded its compliance record by securing a second DGCA Type Certification for the Sigma 100, an indigenous multi-mission unmanned aerial vehicle optimized for advanced LiDAR, surveying, and infrastructure inspections.

The company reports delivering over 165 projects, mapping more than 58,000 square kilometers, and serving major corporate and public entities including GAIL, NTPC, Coal India, Tata Power, Indian Oil, Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation (MRVC), and Essel Mining.
Government procurement tracking records show the company has bid on 18 public tenders, achieving awards that include multiple pipeline surveillance and monitoring works for IndianOil.
claims.note: the specific number of 18 public tenders could not be confirmed in the tracking record sources

claims.claim: The company reported an unaudited revenue of ₹664 Lakhs (₹6.64 crore) and a net loss after tax of ₹111 Lakhs for the period from April 1, 2024, to September 30, 2024, as disclosed in the consolidated financial statements of its strategic investor, CE Info Systems Limited (MapmyIndia).
claims.source: CE Info Systems Limited Q2 FY2024-25 Financial Results Filing on NSE India

claims.claim: The company secured a strategic venture capital investment of ₹7 crore from MapmyIndia in February 2023 for a 20% equity stake to scale its operations and expand drone service delivery capabilities.
claims.source: MapmyIndia Press Release / VCCircle / Business Standard (February 2023)

claims.claim: Indrones Solutions Pvt. Ltd. reports carrying out large-scale aerial mapping across more than 25 states in India, capturing geospatial data across diverse terrains and administrative regions.

The company reports active service footprints covering over 15 states for its DGCA type-certified Sigma25G drone platform, alongside mapping more than 300,000 villages across India under the federal SVAMITVA rural land administration initiative.
claims.corrected: The company reports active service footprints covering over 15 states for its DGCA type-certified Sigma25G drone platform, alongside mapping more than 10,000 villages across India under the federal SVAMITVA rural land administration initiative.
claims.note: Indrones has mapped over 10,000 villages under the SVAMITVA scheme, not 300,000 villages.
claims.source: Indrones Official Platform Publications / FedTech Association Records

claims.claim: In February 2023, the geospatial and digital mapping entity MapmyIndia completed a strategic investment of ₹7 crore for a 20% stake in Indrones Solutions Pvt. Ltd. to jointly provide drone-based solutions and high-definition 3D maps.

In February 2026, the company announced that its proprietary Eigenspace Suite software had been officially integrated into Bentley Systems’ global Ecosystem Catalog to enable digital twin and infrastructure engineering workflows.
The company reports an employee strength of over 100 individuals and cumulative flight hours exceeding 9,000 hours.

status.main_product: Agricultural and industrial drones and Drone-as-a-Service (DaaS) operations
status.scope_reason: The company provides comprehensive commercial drone services under its own brand via a dedicated Drone-as-a-Service (DaaS) vertical covering agricultural spraying and infrastructure monitoring.
status.evidence: According to the company's official website and registry data on ZaubaCorp, Etherealflights Private Limited is an active entity providing end-to-end drone solutions and commercial Drone-as-a-Service (DaaS) operations.

claims.claim: The company reports operating an asset fleet that includes DGCA-certified spray drones for agricultural operations and 1 VTOL unit with a 2+ hour flight time featuring fixed-wing efficiency for surveying and mapping missions.
The company manufactures and utilizes specialized drone platforms, specifically the Ethereal-Agribot-10 and the Ethereal-Agribot-16 agriculture drones.

The company reports developing customized drone designs, agricultural drone models such as the Ethereal Agribot 10 and Ethereal Agribot 16, and proprietary flight controllers built for precision applications.
Etherealflights Pvt. Ltd. reports operating as a DGCA-approved Remote Pilot Training Organization to train and certify drone pilots.
The company reports having general associations and partnerships with the Prime Minister's Office (PMO), Ministry of Defence (MOD), and other unnamed ministries.

The company reports impact metrics such as a 98% reduction in inspection inefficiencies and up to a 30% cost reduction. Based on primary research, the company has not disclosed specific external client identities or specific contract awards.
The company has an authorized share capital of ₹60,00,000 and a paid-up capital of ₹46,00,000 as of its registration records.
The company reports its workflows allow plug-and-play integration with third-party software and AI, though no specific technology partner names are disclosed.

The company reports operating a Drone-as-a-Service (DaaS) vertical for sectors like agriculture spraying and surveillance, employing field supervisors in Pune to coordinate schedules and oversee drone pilots and ground staff.
Etherealflights Pvt. Ltd. lists its corporate size category as 11–50 employees on its official professional network profile and operates a DGCA-approved Remote Pilot Training Organization.
